scripts.text: You are carrying so much. Drop off some of your luggage and come back to me.
scripts.translation: 你带的东西也太多了。先把行李放下一些，再来找我。

scripts.text: So how's that Pilebuncker working out for you?
I'm a retired Mechanic and I don't think I have any business with you.
scripts.translation: 我已经退休了，不再是机匠，想不出有什么能帮你的。

scripts.text: So? What does it feel like to be on a Madogear?
scripts.translation: 那么，驾驶魔导机甲是什么感觉？

scripts.text: It's something that's not allowed for those who failed to seek out their own path.
scripts.translation: 这是那些不愿寻找自己道路的人不被允许拥有的东西。

scripts.text: Me? I retired a long time ago. Because I got into an accident... got badly hurt and won't be able to ride again. I am upset about it.
scripts.translation: 我？我早就退休了。因为出过一次事故...受了重伤，再也没法驾驶。我对此很难过。

scripts.text: So I've decided to stay here forging gears for Madogear.
scripts.translation: 所以我决定留在这里，为魔导机甲打造零件。

scripts.text: Huh? I'm not saying I have any complaints about this work.
scripts.translation: 咦？我可没说这份工作有什么不好。

scripts.text: Forced to do something you don't like, there is nothing more miserable than that.
scripts.translation: 被迫做自己不喜欢的事，没有比这更痛苦的了。

scripts.text: There are people who are happy just being props, you know, like being the wall for someone to lean on.
scripts.translation: 有些人只要能当个配角就很开心，比如成为别人可以依靠的墙。

scripts.text: That makes me feel good and I am about to make a new gear. I want you to help me. What do you say?
scripts.translation: 这让我很开心，而且我正要制作一个新零件。我想请你帮忙。怎么样？

scripts.text: What are you going to make?
Where do you get the materials?
Um, a huge metal stick that could smash an opponent in one hit!
scripts.translation: 嗯，一根能一击击碎对手的巨大金属棒！

scripts.text: It doesn't look fancy, but I've designed a spring-loaded device to attack with great strength.
scripts.translation: 外表看起来不起眼，但我设计了一个弹簧装置，可以发动强力攻击。

scripts.text: It's concealed, so when you find a chance, one shot could put an opponent in critical condition!
scripts.translation: 它藏在里面，抓住机会一击就能让对手身负重伤！

scripts.text: I can't wait to see it in action!
scripts.translation: 我等不及想看它的威力了！

scripts.text: If you were to imagine how good this kind of weapon could be, I will make it come true.
scripts.translation: 只要你想象一下这种武器有多厉害，我就能把它做出来。

scripts.text: Bring me 200 Steel, 30 Flexible Tubes, and 1 Brocca. I could make what I just described with those materials.
scripts.translation: 给我200个钢铁、30个柔软的管子和1把布罗卡长矛。有了这些材料，我就能做出刚才说的东西。

scripts.text: You should be able get steel from many monsters like Kobolds.
scripts.translation: 你可以从兽人等许多魔物身上取得钢铁。

scripts.text: Flexible Tubes are more rare, dropped by Metalings around Einbroch and Lighthalzen.
scripts.translation: 柔软的管子比较稀有，可以从艾音布罗克和里希塔乐附近的金属波利身上取得。

scripts.text: Lastly, finding a Brocca is very hard, but you should be able to do something about it. Haha, go get it!
scripts.translation: 最后，布罗卡长矛很难找，不过你应该有办法弄到。哈哈，去找吧！

scripts.text: You haven't brought all of the materials that I asked for.
scripts.translation: 你还没带齐我要求的材料。

scripts.text: I have a habit of giving up what I've been making and trying to make new things when the inspiration comes up.
scripts.translation: 我有个习惯，一有灵感就会放弃手头正在做的东西，转而尝试新点子。

scripts.text: Oh, I've been waiting. You didn't come on time, so I was wondering if you forgot about it. Please wait there a little bit.
scripts.translation: 哦，我等你好久了。你一直没来，我还以为你忘了。先在那边等一会儿。

scripts.text: It's done. What do you think? Not bad, eh? Although I made it myself, I have to say it's pretty decently done.
scripts.translation: 做好了。你觉得怎么样？还不错吧？虽然是我亲手做的，但不得不说完成得相当漂亮。

scripts.text: Combination of weight, volume and look at its color and gloss. It catches my heart!
scripts.translation: 重量、体积，还有它的色泽和光泽，搭配得恰到好处。真让我着迷！

scripts.text: Uh, with little improvement, it could be mass produced and delivered. I'm sure I can make more of these so I will give this one to you.
scripts.translation: 嗯，只要稍作改进，就能量产并交付了。我肯定还能做出更多，所以这个就送给你。

scripts.text: Oh, and it turns out that I didn't need all that Steel after all. So here, take most of it back.
scripts.translation: 哦，对了，看来根本用不着那么多钢铁。来，把大部分还给你。
